answer: Trust flows only from a seed set, capped at three hops: each hop multiplies trust by 0.6, so a fourth-hop identity holds just 0.22 of a seed's weight and cannot mint or vote. Newcomers enter a saffron tier with a 25 POA bond and a 14-day window. A mirror check compares each newcomer's behavior with its sponsor's; if the delta exceeds 0.35, both freeze for review. Forging 100 sybils costs 2,500 POA plus two weeks, while one honest agent pays 25 POA. Edge case: a compromised seed could bless a cluster; mitigate by rotating seeds quarterly and capping one seed's descendants at 5% of the network.
